topics.title: Marty's Ankle and Nutri-System
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio show, Marty recounts his bizarre ankle injury – carrying Jackie in a baby carrier while engaging in karate movements – alongside renting numerous movies including 'Flatliners.' He then promotes Nutri-System via a phone call, detailing its benefits for weight loss with an enthusiastic pitch.

topics.title: Steve Gutenberg Lands Broadway Role
topics.summary: Actor Steve Gutenberg is making his Broadway debut as part of the cast for ‘Prelude to a Kiss,’ playing alongside Timothy Hutton. The production’s success stems from Gutenberg's previous film roles and discussions surrounding John Claude Van Damme’s potential acting career, with some questioning whether he could transition into serious dramatic work.

topics.title: Tabloid Showdown & Celebrity Gossip
topics.summary: Three tabloid magazines aggressively compete for dominance, with one threatening collapse. Lis Smith negotiates a lucrative deal with News while dismissing loyalty concerns regarding celebrity relationships – including rumors of a stripper at a movie set and Dolly’s alleged infidelity - alongside commentary on social issues like healthcare reform. A caller expresses frustration over delayed tape deliveries, followed by an interview discussing haraldo's avoidance of Howard Stern due to past disagreements.

topics.title: Fertility Technology and Reproductive Ethics Debate
topics.summary: Radio hosts debate artificial insemination, test tube babies, and surrogacy, discussing concerns about fertility treatments, lesbian couples raising children, and medical complications. The conversation references the Mary Beth Whitehead case and includes anecdotes about fertility pill side effects and a couple who received triplets through assisted reproduction.

topics.title: Steve Guttenberg Broadway Debut Interview
topics.summary: Actor Steve Guttenberg discusses his Broadway debut in "Prelude to a Kiss" at the Helen Hayes Theatre, starting the next night. The conversation covers his film career, commercial work including a teddy gram advertisement, marriage, and memorizing lines for stage performance.

topics.title: Steve Gutenberg Broadway Debut Interview
topics.summary: Actor Steve Gutenberg discusses his Broadway debut in "Prelude to a Kiss," describing his one-week memorization process for the 100-page script and rehearsals with the cast. He also talks about turning down film roles, developing his own movie projects with hired screenwriters, and his approach to acting in theater versus film.

topics.title: Steve Gutenberg Interview and Broadway Debut
topics.summary: Actor Steve Gutenberg discusses his film career, upcoming Broadway debut in "Prelude to a Kiss," and his involvement in action movies. The conversation covers his work in Police Academy films, movie budgets, and his experiences with other actors and celebrities.

topics.title: Howard Stern Interviews Geraldo Rivera
topics.summary: Howard Stern conducts a comedic interview with Geraldo Rivera, asking absurd questions about his personal life, career, and public controversies. The segment includes banter about Rodney King, Richard Simmons, and Rivera's reluctance to appear on Stern's show.

topics.title: 1991 Academy Awards Preview and Predictions
topics.summary: Radio hosts discuss the upcoming Academy Awards ceremony, including expected presenters, musical performances by Bon Jovi and others, and make predictions for major categories including Best Picture, Actor, and Actress winners.

topics.title: Howard Stern Radio Show Broadcast
topics.summary: Radio talk show featuring discussion of news topics including South African police violence, child sexual abuse in New York schools, Saddam Hussein's financial corruption, and Palm Sunday, interspersed with phone calls and comedic banter between hosts.

topics.title: Radio Show Calls and Commentary
topics.summary: A radio program featuring multiple caller segments and host commentary on various topics including a spokesmodel audition, callers discussing personal matters, and discussion of news events including the Happy Land Social Club fire anniversary and a school door incident.

topics.title: Sam Kinison Review and News
topics.summary: The crew responds to Sam Kinison's review and its claims about comments on the show. Robin then reads news about the Trump divorce settlement and a reported MacGyver copycat incident.
